documents.title: Board Meeting Outcome for Un-Audited Financial Results Of The Company For The Quarter And Half Year Ended 30.09.2026 And Conduct Of Postal Ballot
Board Meeting Intimation for Considering And Approving Inter-Alia The Un- Audited Financial Results (Standalone And Consolidated) Of The Company For The Quarter And Half Year Ended 30.09.2026
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Nitta Gelatin reported a landmark fiscal year marked by its Golden Jubilee, successful commissioning of the Collagen Peptide Project, and progress on the Gelatin Expansion Project. Management navigated global trade uncertainties through market diversification, customer-focused strategies, and risk management. The Nitta Gelatin Group unveiled a long-term management vision targeting doubled net sales and 2.5 times operating income by March 2033. The company also sought shareholder approval for material related party transactions with group entities for the upcoming period. Management reported steady business volume growth and strong plant utilization during the year, driven by expanding pharmaceutical and nutraceutical sectors.

guidance.claim: The Nitta Gelatin Group targeted doubling net sales and increasing operating income by 2.5 times by the fiscal year ending March 2033.
guidance.quote: In November 2025, the Nitta Gelatin Group unveiled its Long-Term Management Vision, which sets an ambitious target of doubling net sales and increasing operating income by 2.5 times by the fiscal year ending March 2033.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the outlook for the gelatin industry remains encouraging, supported by growing demand across pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, food, and specialty applications.
demand_outlook.quote: The outlook for the gelatin industry also remains encouraging, supported by growing demand across pharmaceutical, nutraceutical, food and specialty applications.

capex_expansion.claim: The ground-breaking ceremony of the company's Collagen Peptide expansion project was held on April 30, 2024 at Kakkanad, Kochi.
capex_expansion.quote: The Ground-Breaking ceremony (Bhumi Pooja) of your Company’s Collagen Peptide expansion project was held on April 30, 2024 at its factory located in Kakkanad, Kochi.

capex_expansion.claim: The Collagen Peptide expansion project is expected to be commissioned by the middle of next year.
capex_expansion.quote: The project is expected to be commissioned by the middle of next year.

risks_headwinds.claim: The year was marked by heightened uncertainty in the global trade environment following tariff measures introduced by the United States.
risks_headwinds.quote: The year was marked by heightened uncertainty in the global trade environment following tariff measures introduced by the United States, which impacted international supply chains and trade flows.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that geopolitical developments, regional conflicts, global trade flow volatility, and potential tariff measures by major economies warrant continued caution.
risks_headwinds.quote: Notwithstanding the positive domestic outlook, uncertainties arising from geopolitical developments, regional conflicts, volatility in global trade flows and the potential continuation or expansion of tariff measures by major economies, including the United States, warrant continued caution.

management_commitments.claim: The Nitta Gelatin Group set a target to double net sales and increase operating income by 2.5 times by the fiscal year ending March 2033.
management_commitments.quote: In November 2025, the Nitta Gelatin Group unveiled its Long-Term Management Vision, which sets an ambitious target of doubling net sales and increasing operating income by 2.5 times by the fiscal year ending March 2033.

management_commitments.claim: The Collagen Peptide expansion project at Kakkanad is expected to be commissioned by the middle of next year.
management_commitments.quote: The project is expected to be commissioned by the middle of next year.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
